tei:div.tei:p:
Thank the Lord, invoke His Name, proclaim His deeds among the peoples. Sing to Him, play music to Him, tell of all His wonders. Take pride in His holy Name; let the heart of those who seek the Lord, rejoice. Search for the Lord and His strength, seek His countenance constantly. Remember His wonders which He has performed, His signs and the judgments of His mouth. O seed of His servant Israel, sons of Jacob His elect, He is the Lord our God, over the whole earth are His judgments. Remember for ever His convenantcovenant, the word which He has commanded for thousands of generations, which He contracted with Abraham and swore to Isaac.
He established it as Law for Jacob, for Israel as an eternal convenantcovenant, saying: To you will I give the land of Canaan as the portion of your inheritance, though you are small in number, few and strangers in it. They wandered from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people. He let no man oppress them and rebuked kings because of them. Do not touch my anointed ones, to my prophets do no harm. Sing to the Lord, all the earth, proclaim from day to day His salvation. Tell of His glory among the nations and among all peoples of His wonders. For great is the Lord and most renowned, and more awe-inspiring than all deities. For all the deities of the peoples are idols — the Lord has made the heavens. Splendour and beauty are before Him, might and glory are in His place. Ascribe to the Lord, O families of the peoples, ascribe to the Lord honour and might. Ascribe to the Lord the glory of His Name, bring a gift and come before Him, bow before the Lord in sacred adornment. Tremble before Him, all the earth, though the world be firm and does not totter. Let the heavens rejoice and the earth revel and among the nations let them say: The Lord reigns. Let the sea roar and the fullness of it, let the field and all that is in it be joyful. Then will trees of the forest exult before the Lord when He comes to judge the earth. Thank the Lord for He is good, for His grace endures for ever. And say: Save us, God of our salvation, and gather us and deliver us from the nations, so that we may thank Thy holy Name and extol Thy fame. Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, from eternity to eternity. And the whole people said Amen and praised the Lord.
